jobs.title: Full-Stack Web Engineer (IT-PW-WDA-2026-108-GRAE)
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

We are looking for a full-stack software developer with DevOps experience. In this role, you will be a member of the Web, DevOps and Authoring section in the IT-PW group.

We have been consolidating all Web hosting services on our Platform as a Service (PaaS) infrastructure based on OpenShift/OKD4, including the supported CERN Web Content Management Systems (Drupal, WordPress). By joining us, you will support and contribute to the continuous improvement of .CERN top-level domain management and hosting.

CERN is managing its own top level internet domain. This generic top-level domain (gTLD) is used for hosting highly visible public websites such as CERN, Careers, openlab, etc.

**Your responsibilities:**

* Supporting and further integration of the handling of the top-level domain .CERN, including the process of certificate procurement and automation of certificate renewal.
* Implementation of features for the CERN Web infrastructure services, including the Web Services Portal and dedicated functionality such as information retrieval from .CERN sites and extensions to the hosting mechanisms used for .CERN sites.

**Your profile:**

* Experience with full-stack software development.
* Experience with version control systems and CI/CD workflows.
* Experience with container orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes / OpenShift is a plus.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with a proactive mindset to identify challenges and drive innovative solutions.
* Good communication and collaboration skills, with ability to work effectively within cross-functional teams.
* Strong commitment to user satisfaction, actively seeking feedback and collaborating with users to continuously improve services.

Skills:

* Programming in Python, JavaScript, React.
* Knowledge of Web protocols and technologies (including certificates).
* Git, CI/CD tools, test and deployment automation.
* Knowledge of Web Content Management Systems would be an asset.
* Linux and Bash scripting.
* Experience with Kubernetes and/or OpenShift/OKD container technology is a plus.
* Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Eligibility criteria:

* You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State.
* **By the application deadline,** you have a **maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation** in Software or computer engineering (or a related field) **and** **your highest educational qualification is either a Bachelor's or Master's degree**.
* You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.
* Applicants without University degree are not eligible.
* Applicants with a PhD are not eligible.

  
**Additional Information**

Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.

Working hours: 40 hours per week

Job flexibility: Hybrid

Target start date: 01-June-2026

Job reference: IT-PW-WDA-2026-108-GRAE

Field of work: Software Engineering and IT

Benchmark job: 200020 - Computing Engineer

**Global Benefits**

* A monthly net stipend of either 5266 or 5793 Swiss Francs per month depending on your degree.
* 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.
* Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.
* Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.
* A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.
* Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.
* On-the-job and formal training including language classes.

**Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!**

At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.

Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.

If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe! **TAKE PART!**

**More information about us, here:** **careers.cern**

jobs.title: HVAC & Utilities Engineer DPS Growth Project 80-100% (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in **Stein, AG, Switzerland**. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

As an HVAC & Utilities Engineer, you ensure the GMP‑compliant, safe, and energy‑efficient operation of Black Utilities, Clean Utilities, and HVAC systems within our new sterile Drug Product facility. During the start‑up phase of this global strategic growth project, you will significantly contribute to designing and implementing an optimal operational set‑up. In routine operations, you are responsible for system reliability, regulatory compliance, and up‑to‑date documentation in alignment with applicable guidelines and SOPs.

This position is part of our Drug Product Services (DPS) Business Unit in Stein, Switzerland, a CDMO environment supporting customers in solving some of the most complex challenges in modern therapeutics.

**What you will get**

* An agile career and a dynamic work culture.
* An inclusive and ethical workplace.
* Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below.

**Benefits in Stein:** https://media.ffycdn.net/eu/lonza-group-ag/d/3cf206339e0e4e41a77e8c806138c2b5?lz=2

**What you will do:**

* Participate in FATs, construction walkdowns, commissioning, and qualification to ensure a smooth handover of Black Utilities, Clean Utilities, and HVAC systems
* Ensure safe, cGMP‑compliant operation and execution of maintenance activities after handover
* Maintain complete, accurate, and up‑to‑date system documentation
* Support risk analyses and create SOPs and work instructions for the new facility and assigned equipment
* Maintain qualification status of responsible areas in line with safety and GMP requirements
* Manage deviations and changes across the assigned system landscape
* Act as subject matter expert (SME) during audits and inspections for all HVAC & Utilities topics

**What we are looking for:**

* Degree in engineering (HF, FH, Dipl. Ing., B.Sc., M.Sc.) or a comparable technical education with strong technical understanding
* Proficiency in German (required); English skills preferred
* Significant experience in equipment maintenance, ideally in a pharmaceutical GMP environment
* Strong knowledge of SAP‑PM and MS Office
* Analytical mindset with the ability to define and track KPIs
* Familiarity with GMP compliance requirements preferred
* Ability to work collaboratively in a dynamic project and operational setting

**About Lonza**

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

**Ready to shape the future of life sciences?**

**Apply now.**

jobs.title: Software Developer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
#### **Your mission**

As a Software Developer in our IT team, you develop applications based on various technologies and thus drive the digitalization and automation of our processes. You analyze internal requirements and develop suitable solution concepts. Your responsibilities cover the entire development process from design to programming, the test phase and implementation to the further development of the respective software solutions.

#### **Your profile**

**YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Backend software development and maintenance of business-critical applications
* Design, development and integration of RESTful APIs, JSON and other interfaces between internal and external systems
* Troubleshooting and resolving issues in production environments
* SQL development and maintenance of SQL code (MS SQL)
* Planning and implementation of system integrations (e.g. EDI connections) as well as adaptations of the workflow-based ERP system
* Software-related IT support and ticket handling

**WHAT YOU BRING**  

* You enjoy programming, testing and launching creative software solutions
* You work in a structured, independent and goal-oriented manner
* You have strong analytical skills
* You are passionate about quality, innovation and digitalization
* You enjoy working in a young, dynamic and multicultural team

**YOUR QUALIFICATIONS**

* Proven experience in backend development in a production environment
* Solid knowledge of databases (MS SQL) - writing and optimizing SQL queries, stored procedures and database administration
* Good understanding of RESTful APIs, JSON and communication protocols between applications and servers
* Experience troubleshooting issues in a production environment
* Programming skills in C# are an advantage; experience with any modern programming language is welcome
* Experience with system integrations (e.g. EDI, APIs) is a plus
* Knowledge of UI/UX/design and workflow applications is a plus
* Knowledge of Python is a plus
* You have good English skills; German is a plus

#### **Why us?**

**WE OFFER:**  
Depending on your qualifications and experience, the gross monthly salary starts at €3,700. We are happy to offer a higher salary depending on your experience and qualifications.

* Flexible working hours
* A secure position within a family-oriented company culture in a stable and future-focused industry
* The opportunity to work in a young, dynamic team
* Ongoing training and professional development opportunities

**Our benefits**

* Free parking directly at the office
* Complimentary shuttle service to and from Wörgl train station
* Discounted fuel at our on-site filling station (diesel)
* Company bike leasing program for sustainable mobility
* Monthly grocery allowance
* Health and wellness benefits, including an occupational physician, vaccination programs, and team sports activities
* Regular company events and team-building activities
* Support in finding accommodation

Welcome to Transped Group – your specialist for European transport since 1983! As a traditional family business, we combine expertise and quality with a personal approach to customer service.
